name: braindance
description: Volumetric capture and non-linear editing for the Kinect v2: a native grabber, a Node server, a browser point-cloud viewer, a take recorder and library, a keyframe editor and a render queue.
author: Tim Kraus <tim@timkraus.eu>

scripts.fixtures: node tools/make-sample.mjs captures/sample.knct --if-missing && node tools/make-fixture.js captures/sample.knct captures/fixture-1g.knct --loops 8
scripts.test:offline: node tools/syntax-check.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs && node tools/release-gate-check.mjs
